title: Add CSV export for orders
goal: Add shop.report.to_csv(orders) that renders orders as RFC 4180 CSV.
acceptance_criteria: first line is the header id,customer,total
one line per order in input order; total is formatted with exactly two decimals (ints, floats and Decimals alike)
fields containing a comma, a double quote or a newline are quoted with doubled quotes
lines end with CRLF including the last one; an empty list yields only the header line
